title: Hollow Warden
description: This is a hollow warden by ItsXoloti, I edited the colours a bit and now it really is in the dark!
body:
This is a edited version of the hollow warden that pixletoast created. The fan art that was used was created ItsXoloti

(you can check out the orginal edited version here https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/hallow-warden-for-1-19/  )

 

This basiclly adds the hollow knight to minecraft in the version of a warden.....

![Hollow warden front](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8819890b5bc89c822eb240da0d1eb926a96bcc63.png)

![Hollow warden back](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7931c390b708b580d83e8463be14b66404bcaa4d.png)

You can also download this from my curseforge profile if you want to give some support there too! https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/hollow-warden
